races.verdict: AGE OF TIME shaped well last time and may make his second start for Tony Carroll a winning one. Mount Ruapehu is feared in his bid to make it 4-4 over C&D and heads the dangers along with interesting stable-switcher Mehmar . Due Date and Papa Don't Preach also merit consideration in a race where several look potentially well treated. AGE OF TIME (FR) MOUNT RUAPEHU (IRE) MEHMAR (IRE)
